name: Crown of Ash
premise: The tyrant king is dead and three heirs claim the throne. The party are hired swords who suddenly hold the one item all three heirs want.
setting: Forgotten Realms — a small realm in the Border Kingdoms, south of the Lake of Steam, 1491 DR
tone: Grimdark political intrigue: morally grey, every victory costs something

last_summary.text: Days 11 to 13 of the interregnum. After the ward's first nights, Sister Ilsa came to the forge lane at night with Kitwin, slipping the Pyrehouse, and Chadickith brought them in; Ilsa begged that Kitwin not be asked to choose before the council. Chadickith rested, won the Vent Games grudge pit and the Long Soak's cider and wager at the Third Vent, named Captain Marda his 1492 Champion's Grudge challenger, and took a long rest. At dawn on day 13 Branda Cobb asked what the Quenching would make her and said she will answer at dusk with her mother listening. At noon the Lamplit Council sat for the first time: after Chadickith spoke (a natural 20), the eighteen-lamp elder-seat draft passed 7 to 5 and a healing budget 10 to 2; the Pyrehouse got its lamp but custody of Kitwin failed 2 to 10, so he stays under Halda's seal in the Collarhouse; Rook refused the lamps, the Choir's flame-silver stays sealed, and the Grudge Circuit passed 7 to 5. Marda hands Halda the sealed parentage record by 08:00 on day 14, and Branda's answer is due at dusk on day 13.

dm_notes:
SECRET: Garn (bound, gagged, 0 HP stable) wakes in 3 hours from the end of round 1 of the Pyre fight. Kitwin was taken toward the Pyrehouse lane by Sister Ilsa + one other.
